## Church leaders

Extend the audit to the whole institution — budget, facilities, hiring, worship accessibility across socioeconomic lines, and the church's digital presence. Launch a **Digital Jubilee initiative**: skills training, device access, and advocacy against digital exclusion in your parish footprint. Rethink missions and charity toward long-term development and root causes; teach Kingdom economics; and keep the fruit dashboard honest about whom your community actually reaches. Where policy shapes injustice, be a prophetic witness in the public square — outcomes over lip service, as Module 7 committed.
